title: Songbook and Tide
author: Wren Halloran
blurb: Wren Zhou, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
